therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with relapsed or refractory lymphoma or multiple myeloma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: dose-limiting toxicity, MTD (Phase I); complete and partial response rate (Phase II)

results.effect_size: 6 partial responses out of enrolled patients across dose levels; 0 complete responses
results.target_engagement_evidence: Pharmacodynamic effects on PBMCs assessed on Day 1; PK data collected (AUC Day 1: 10.404 hr×μM, Day 22: 11.949 hr×μM; Cmax Day 1: 1.954 μM, Day 22: 2.071 μM)
biomarker_changes: Pharmacodynamic effects on normal PBMCs assessed on Day 1
subgroup_findings: Partial responses observed: 2 at dose level 1, 2 at dose level 2, 2 at dose level 3
No complete responses at any dose level
Cohort 1: 3 partial responses, 0 stable disease; Cohort 2: 2 partial responses, 0 stable disease; Cohort 4: 0 partial responses, 3 stable disease
8 patients reported acute infusion toxicity (fever, hypotension, tumor pain, dyspnea)
safety_signals: Leukopenia in 86% of patients across all dose levels
8 patients reported acute infusion toxicity including fever, hypotension, tumor pain, and dyspnea
No dose-limiting toxicities observed at any of the three dose levels

dose_info.dose: 30 mg/m2 + 30 mg/m2 (Level 1); 30 mg/m2 + 50 mg/m2 (Level 2); 50 mg/m2 + 50 mg/m2 (Level 3)
dose_info.schedule: IV administration; Days 1 and 22 of Cycle 1 (28-day cycle)

context.indication: relapsed or refractory lymphoma or multiple myeloma
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was administratively complete. No dose-limiting toxicities were observed at any dose level. MTD was determined to be 100 mg/m2 (50+50 mg/m2). Partial responses were observed across all dose levels with no complete responses. The trial aimed to identify subsets of lymphoid/plasma cell malignancies suitable for larger Phase II studies.
